processor.color: PIL Image.convert('RGB') when mode != RGB (no alpha compositing); tvF.pil_to_tensor -> uint8 CHW
processor.smart_resize: factor = patch_size * merge_size = 32; see smart_resize_reference() in hf_vision_reference.py
processor.resample: PILImageResampling.BICUBIC -> torchvision.transforms.v2.functional.resize(uint8 CHW, [h, w], InterpolationMode.BICUBIC, antialias=True): Keys cubic a=-0.5, separable, uint8 clamp+round after each pass (matches PIL Image.BICUBIC within 1 level)
processor.normalize: float32: (x * rescale - mean) / std, fused as (x - mean/rescale) / (std/rescale)
processor.patch_order: block-major: (grid_h/2, grid_w/2, 2, 2) -> row = ((bh*2 + ih) * grid_w) ... i.e. merge blocks in raster order, 2x2 patches row-major inside each block
processor.row_layout: channel(3) x temporal(2) x patch_row(16) x patch_col(16) = 1536, channel-major; the two temporal frames are identical copies of the still image
